preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a_i, b_i) has vertices between 1 and n inclusive, and a_i is not equal to b_i.

postconditions.expression: all(x not in Q for x, y in edges if y in Q)
postconditions.description: No two vertices in Q are connected by an edge.

postconditions.expression: all(any(x in Q or any(z in Q for z in neighbors[x]) for x in range(1, n+1) if x not in Q))
postconditions.description: Every vertex not in Q is reachable from some vertex in Q in at most two moves.
The number of selected vertices k is equal to the length of the set Q.
